rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it overstates confidence in a discrete upper-left ICM and cohesive AA TE from this single image; some described granularity/borderline A-B features are somewhat speculative.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, endometriosis, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat mechanistic probability adjustments and a few speculative inferences.

Largely evidence-based on morphology, age counseling, smoking cessation, and consideration of PGT-A, but includes some recommendations that are not standard or are controversial for routine use (ERA, ReceptivaDx, growth hormone, DHEA, routine estradiol addition, high-dose folate without clear indication).

Provides clear immediate transfer recommendations, lifestyle modifications, luteal support considerations, and concrete future-cycle planning options including PGT-A, endometrial workup, and counseling.
